manifest.title: Dataset manifest
manifest.description: JSON manifest with train (or data), optional val and optional test lists. Each labeled image has image_path (relative to the manifest) and points: [x,y] for centers or [x1,y1,x2,y2] for directed annotations. A submitted annotation with no points exports points: []; missing points means no submitted supervision and is skipped.

localisation.title: Localisation weights
localisation.description: Optional path to localisation model checkpoint. If omitted, the checkpoint downloaded during model installation is used.

orientation.title: Enable orientations
orientation.description: Whether to use orientations during training/inference.

display_interval.title: Evaluation interval
display_interval.description: Epoch count between full training, validation and test evaluation passes and diagnostic visualisations. Evaluation also runs after the final epoch.

evaluate_training.title: Evaluate training set
evaluate_training.description: Calculate evaluation metrics on all labeled training images at each evaluation step.

visualization_samples.title: Training samples to visualise
visualization_samples.description: Maximum number of training samples visualised at each evaluation step. Metrics cover all labeled training images; every validation/test image is visualised.

visualization_score_threshold.title: Visualization score threshold
visualization_score_threshold.description: Minimum center score for figures when evaluation is disabled. Evaluated splits automatically use their own threshold maximizing dataset-wide F1; this setting never filters evaluation candidates.

width.title: Image width
width.description: Width to transform image to (should be divisible by 32).

height.title: Image height
height.description: Height to transform image to (should be divisible by 32).

epochs.title: Training duration
epochs.description: Number of epochs to train for.
